name: Tank
dimensions: height 5.3 cm; width 9.6 cm; depth 5.5 cm
summary: This is a friction driven tin toy, made in China. When pushed the wheels engage a large flywheel inside which stores the kinetic energy of the initial acceleration and propels the toy forward after it is released.
